KNOW YOUR INDEX

One scale.
Five air-quality levels.

IPU is Malaysia’s Air Pollutant Index (API). This dashboard uses the Malaysian scale and the colours shown by MyEQMS.

Independent dashboard · Data: Department of Environment Malaysia / MyEQMS
Not an official government application. Check the official portal for advisories.

Updates, installation & privacy

On iPhone: open in Safari, use Share, then Add to Home Screen. Enable Open as Web App if offered. The Udara icon opens a standalone app window. Location access still requires your permission.

Readings are retrieved from MyEQMS when you open this app, return after more than five minutes away, or tap Refresh. There is no timed data polling. Refresh retrieves the latest available observation; it does not trigger a new government measurement. Your recorded history is stored only in this browser and can have gaps. Readings older than 3 hours are marked outdated. Your coordinates are used only in your browser to find the nearest Malaysian station; they are not stored or sent to this site’s server. Your selected station is remembered on this device. Loading a map connects to OpenStreetMap and shares the selected station’s coordinates, not your exact position.
